objective.statement: Redesign the empty dashboard state in web/dashboard/EmptyState.tsx so new users understand what to do next.
objective.success_definition: Three new users complete onboarding without asking for help.

goals.statement: Redesign the empty dashboard state in web/dashboard/EmptyState.tsx so new users understand what to do next.
acceptance: Three new users complete onboarding without asking for help.

assumptions.statement: The redesign is limited to the single file web/dashboard/EmptyState.tsx and does not require changes to other components or onboarding flows.
The success criterion of three new users completing onboarding without asking for help will be evaluated through a manual user-testing session rather than an automated test.

open_questions.question: What specific content, actions, or guidance should the redesigned empty state present to new users (e.g., primary call-to-action, onboarding steps, links to docs)?
options: A short list of onboarding steps

open_questions.question: How will the 'three new users complete onboarding without asking for help' criterion be tested and measured (e.g., moderated usability test, analytics funnel)?
options: Moderated usability testing with three participants

verification.spec: Have three new users go through onboarding with the redesigned empty dashboard state and observe whether they complete onboarding without asking for help.
verification.expected: All three new users complete onboarding without asking for help.

verification.spec: Review the changes to confirm only web/dashboard/EmptyState.tsx was modified, existing design tokens are used, and no new dependencies were added.
verification.expected: Diff is confined to web/dashboard/EmptyState.tsx, uses existing design tokens, and introduces no new dependencies.

deliverables.description: Redesigned empty dashboard state in web/dashboard/EmptyState.tsx.

factors: Success criterion depends on a small-sample human usability test (three users), which is subjective and not automatable.
Scope is confined to a single file with explicit constraints, limiting blast radius.
